title: Job overview and status panel
consumers: US-025 accepted, active, terminal and recovery details
guidance: Remove trivial status explanations. Make survey names the useful content; simplify the overview title/count hierarchy. Align price, metadata and return navigation across reused cases. Preserve last-confirmed context when a read is uncertain.

decisions.title: Survey content and contract action have separate roles
decisions.reason: Surveys are named clearly without bullet/count filler. Show a count only for multiple surveys. Metadata forms one aligned facts grid.

decisions.title: No repeated status paragraph
decisions.reason: Contract holds the lifecycle badge, agreed price and meaningful actions. Remove Work has started / already in progress / offer accepted reminders.

parameters.name: Overview composition
parameters.description: Surveys heading1.125rem; survey names1rem; responsive metadata minimum9rem. Contract stays a separate sibling on desktop and stacks on mobile.

parameters.name: Links/status
parameters.description: Brief links remain recognizable; lifecycle status is not a decorative heading.
